phases.name: No component on conveyor belt
phases.visual_description: The conveyor belt is visible without any electronic component on it; tools and wiring seen nearby but belt area is empty.

phases.name: Red component present on conveyor belt
phases.visual_description: A red electronic component is resting or moving on the conveyor belt, no other components on belt.

phases.name: Green component present on conveyor belt
phases.visual_description: A green electronic component is resting or moving on the conveyor belt, no other components on belt.

uncertainties: Exact motion mechanism of components is not visible, only positional changes are seen.

phases.name: empty cutter area
phases.visual_description: The metal blade arm and the lower metal channel are visible with no cardboard strip crossing the cutting area and no fresh cardboard piece under the blade.

phases.name: strip positioned at cutter
phases.visual_description: A long cardboard strip extends across or into the cutting area near the blade hinge, while the blade arm is raised or partly raised. No separated falling piece is visible yet.

phases.name: blade crossing strip
phases.visual_description: The metal blade arm is swung down across the cardboard strip at the cutting area. The strip is still present at the blade, and the cut is actively being made or just being completed.

phases.name: separated piece below blade
phases.visual_description: A short cardboard piece is visible below/in front of the cutting area after separation, often lying on or leaning against earlier pieces, while another cardboard strip segment may still remain near the blade or be held above by the red gripper.

uncertainties: The exact actuator sequence is only partly visible; the red gripper appears in some frames but is not consistently visible across all phases.
Some frames show both a newly positioned strip and previously cut pieces at once, so the boundary between 'positioned' and 'post-cut' is conservative.
The precise instant of separation is not always visible in the sampled images, so some labels around the cut moment are lower confidence.
